verdict.rationale: SavvyCal documents a REST API with OAuth and personal access tokens. Its endpoints cover core objects: listing, creating and cancelling events, updating and duplicating scheduling links, and fetching available slots. Webhooks and an MCP client integration for managing links and booking meetings round out the programmatic surface. However, nothing claims API parity with the UI, and many UI features have no evidenced API coverage, including workflows, meeting polls, Stripe payments, round-robin and team configuration, delegation, and branding. Missing for 10: an explicit API-parity claim or a full endpoint reference, API coverage for workflows, polls, payments, team and round-robin settings and branding, and independent corroboration.
